items.title: Live: Venezuelans dig for loved ones in Caracas after quakes that caused evacuations 1,700km away
items.description: More than 250 buildings are ruined or damaged after the devastating double quake, president of the National Asembly Jorge Rodríguez says. Follow live.

items.title: Today show host Karl Stefanovic to leave Channel Nine, network confirms
items.description: Today show host Karl Stefanovic will leave Channel Nine after a controversial podcast interview with British far-right figure Tommy Robinson.

items.title: The 'atmosphere of mistrust' looming over Trump and Tehran's war deal
items.description: The Trump administration has been negotiating directly with Iran this week in an effort to reach a long-term peace agreement, but it has several hurdles to clear before it can better the deal the United States already had.

items.title: Live: PM flags strengthening powers of eSafety commissioner for social media ban
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese says the government will look to strengthen the powers of the eSafety commissioner to enforce an under-16s social media ban. Follow live.

items.title: 'An outright lie': Minister challenges Butler on Thriving Kids rollout
items.description: A member of the Thriving Kids advisory panel has voiced concern about how the support program for children with autism and developmental delay is being rolled out.

items.title: Live: Ecuador delirious after Germany upset delivers Socceroos blow
items.description: Ecuador beats Germany 2-1 to almost certainly seal progression to the next round, while Côte d'Ivoire wraps up second spot in Group E with a win over Curaçao. Follow live.

items.title: UN pauses Hormuz Strait evacuation after ship reports attack
items.description: The UN pauses its operation to escort ships through the Strait of Hormuz after a vessel reports an attack.

items.title: Asia has spent 30 years fighting bird flu. Here's what Australia can learn
items.description: Experts say Asia's decades-long experience fighting bird flu has shown there is no magic bullet and that fragmented responses to the disease will fail.

items.title: King won't move into renovated Buckingham Palace, royal funding to be cut
items.description: An annual financial statement released on Thursday contained several revelations, including plans to cut the royal family's public funding, and details of how much tax the monarch paid.

items.title: Live: ASX set to open higher
items.description: The ASX is set to open higher in morning trading after mixed results on Wall Street. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Man suing Spirit of Tasmania operator told he 'should have sat' on ship's toilet
items.description: A man who claims to have sustained injuries after falling over while using a toilet at sea says the ferry operator was negligent, the federal court has heard.

items.title: Seventy years on, the 'town that moved' isn't going anywhere
items.description: Tallangatta moved from its original position 70 years ago. Those who helped the houses on their way remember the event well.

items.title: Dezi Freeman case leads to police gun carry changes
items.description: Chief Commissioner Mike Bush says Victoria Police officers in the state's alpine region will soon be permitted to carry long-arm rifles after the Dezi Freeman case.

items.title: Barring 'ISIS bride' could have triggered High Court challenge
items.description: Legal experts say the Commonwealth would have risked losing a High Court challenge to counterterrorism laws if it stopped the Australian woman from returning home.

items.title: Friday news quiz: Neil the Seal, the Teals party down and Trump drains his swamp
items.description: This week's news quiz features the usual assortment of political animals and regular animals, as well as other odd happenings from across the world.

items.title: 'Not everyone wants to go for a run': Why young adults joined rubbish club
items.description: From recently single, to expats, paid and free clubs designed to help adults make friends are attracting people from all walks of life. As Australians increasingly report feeling lonely, these are the people who are branching out to change that.

items.title: Are these the 20 best albums of 2026 so far?
items.description: If you haven't had the time to keep up with new music this year, we've got you covered. Find your new favourite album here.

items.title: Mixed reaction to beach town at forefront of over-50s lifestyle resort boom
items.description: Four over-50s lifestyle developments have been approved for this small beach community, with two more being assessed. Some worry the area is not ready for the influx, others say it is the answer to the housing crisis.

items.title: New bridge announced but Great Western Highway closed for another year
items.description: A new bridge will be built at Mitchell's Causeway on the Great Western Highway to link Sydney and the state's central west.

items.title: Police close investigation into Liberal MP Moira Deeming's assault allegation
items.description: A Victoria Police spokesperson says a "thorough investigation" into Mrs Deeming's claim she was assaulted by fellow MP Matthew Guy concluded "there was no offence detected".

items.title: Eels coach punches a wall and bemoans 'park football' effort
items.description: Parramatta coach Jason Ryles has said his side's performance on Thursday night was not good enough to "beat a park football", going down 32-12 to the South Sydney Rabbitohs.

items.title: Lions roar back in form with big win over Swans
items.description: The defending champions, Brisbane, make a statement with a big win over second-placed Sydney at the Gabba.

items.title: Jetskiers rescue 'Princess Peach' the turtle stranded on Magnetic Island
items.description: A group of jetski riders were touring Magnetic Island when they stumbled across an injured turtle.

items.title: Veteran fears budget changes 'going to cause more suicides'
items.description: An Australian Defence Force veteran says caps on allied health spending for veterans are a betrayal and that any politician supportive of the changes would not be welcome at Anzac Day events.

items.title: Abalone divers say 41 per cent catch reduction 'a kick in the face'
items.description: The NSW government says a reset is needed to ensure the sustainable future of the abalone fishery along the south coast, but commercial divers say the reduction is a "pretty disgusting state of affairs".
